more_info.overview: Spermaceti is an animal wax associated with the sperm whale. It consists mainly of wax esters, especially cetyl palmitate, with a smaller triglyceride component. It solidifies on cooling and is insoluble in water. This historical glazing-agent entry concerns that wax mixture. It should not be treated as a plant wax or as a description of every synthetic cetyl-palmitate preparation.
more_info.origin: Animal-derived wax historically recovered from the spermaceti organ of sperm whales. The material is a mixture predominantly containing wax esters.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The natural wax is animal derived and is not suitable for vegans or vegetarians. The reviewed description does not establish halal or kosher certification.
